body: This could display a hourglass or something, instead of empty image.
You could also handle `ui_right`/`ui_left` to quickly switch images.

Title Case makes no sense here.
```suggestion
		filter->set_placeholder(TTRC("Search assets (excluding templates). Use tags by including \"#tagname\"."));
```

```suggestion
		filter->set_placeholder(TTRC("Search templates. Use tags by including \"#tagname\"."));
```
Like below, though it was fine before the change. Now it's a sentence.
This check is not reliable. It only checks whether checkbox was toggled, not whether the state actually changed (so toggling something twice will still trigger search).
I wonder, should this option be hidden if there is only one available source? I doubt anyone ever used it.
I fear this would make the page too noisy. Remember that several of those will appear while loading, and considering they will only show for a second or two, I don't think it's worthy.
Wouldn't that clash with the behavior of moving around buttons in the UI? Would be odd if this specific area overrode this.

The buttons in that section of the UI are already quite long in width. Removing this would make them even longer, so I don't think there is harm in leaving it there, since crowdedness isn't a problem.
